meta.title: About us
meta.description: Hidden Antwerp takes you beyond the famous landmarks: self-guided, interactive city walks and pub games through Antwerp's stories, in 8 languages.

about.title: Discover the city beyond the obvious.
about.intro: Hidden Antwerp takes you beyond the famous landmarks. Explore centuries-old streets, uncover forgotten stories, discover authentic local pubs and experience Antwerp through interactive adventures created for curious explorers.

story.title: Our story
story.p1: Hidden Antwerp grew out of a love for this city: its history, its hidden corners and its authentic cafés.
story.p2: We believe the most interesting stories of a city are not always found at its best-known monuments. More often they wait in narrow side streets, behind old gateways, in centuries-old cafés and in buildings that most visitors walk straight past.
story.p3: Hidden Antwerp brings those stories back to life. We combine local history with what your phone does well: interactive maps, GPS navigation that guides you from stop to stop, and playful tasks that make you look twice.
story.p4: Our aim is simple: that you can discover Antwerp on your own, at your own pace, and come home with stories you would never have found in a guidebook.

experiences.title: Our experiences
experiences.intro: Each walk has its own character. Choose the one that suits your company and your mood.

pace.title: Explore at your own pace
pace.text: Start when you like, pause for a coffee, continue tomorrow: your progress waits for you.

stories.title: Authentic local stories
stories.text: History, legends and everyday life, with history and legend always clearly told apart.

gps.title: Interactive, GPS-guided
gps.text: A map shows the way to every stop, and the walk opens the next chapter when you arrive.

groups.title: For friends, couples and groups
groups.text: Walk together on one phone, or play Hidden Pubs as teams, each player on their own phone.

noGuide.title: No tour guide needed
noGuide.text: No meeting point, no fixed times: your phone is your guide, in the browser, without an app.

languages.title: Available in 8 languages
languages.text: English, Dutch, French, Spanish, Italian, German, Russian and Ukrainian.

partners.title: For hotels, cafés and companies
partners.text: Hotels and tourism partners can recommend our walks to their guests with their own partner link. Companies and groups can book a team outing or a private experience.

vision.title: Where we're heading
vision.text: Hidden Antwerp is our first city. Our ambition is to bring the same way of discovering to other Belgian cities such as Ghent, Bruges and Brussels, and later to destinations abroad.
vision.note: This is our plan for the future: today our walks are available in Antwerp only.

meta.title: Reviews
meta.description: What walkers say about Hidden Antwerp: verified reviews from people who did one of our walks.

reviews.title: What our explorers say
reviews.intro: Only people who did one of our walks with a ticket can write a review, one per ticket. We read every review before it appears and never change its words.
reviews.rewarded: Rewarded with a discount code (for any review, whatever the rating)
reviews.empty: No reviews have been published yet. Did a walk with us? You'll find the review link in the email after your walk.
reviews.unavailable: Reviews can't be loaded right now. Please try again later.

leave.title: Leave a review
leave.text: Did a walk with a ticket? When you finish it, you get an email with your personal review link (if you asked for it when buying). One review per ticket, so every review comes from a real walk.
